title: Climate Change, Deforestation, and the Expansion of the Global Agricultural Frontier
abstract: This paper studies how global warming affects deforestation and agricultural land use. Using high-resolution satellite data on global temperature, deforestation, and land cover from 2001 to 2019, we find that extreme heat shocks to agricultural productivity cause large and persistent forest loss on the world’s agricultural frontier. This effect is strongest in the tropics, in areas growing the most temperature-sensitive crops, and in regions with the most inelastic demand for agricultural products, and it does not seem to be offset by international spillovers. Moreover, we show that deforestation in response to extreme heat can be explained almost entirely by cropland expansion. We corroborate these findings using agricultural census data from Brazil, where we find evidence for a mechanism whereby heat reduces yields and raises local agricultural prices, driving cropland expansion but little land use or input adjustment along other margins. Our estimates imply that extreme heat has driven substantial forest loss and that projected warming through 2100 could lead to an additional 28 million hectares of deforestation. Our findings challenge the view that reallocation will soften the environmental consequences of climate change, suggesting instead that farmers double down and expand cropland locally when productivity falls. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 本文研究全球变暖如何影响毁林和农业土地利用。利用2001年至2019年高分辨率的全球气温、毁林和土地覆盖卫星数据，我们发现，极端高温冲击对农业生产力的影响会在世界农业边界地区引发大规模且持续的森林损失。这一效应在热带地区最为强烈，在种植对温度最为敏感作物的地区最为显著，并且在农产品需求最缺乏弹性的地区最为突出，而且似乎不会被国际溢出效应所抵消。此外，我们表明，对极端高温做出的毁林反应几乎可以完全由耕地扩张来解释。我们利用巴西的农业普查数据对这些发现进行了佐证，发现了一种机制：高温降低单产并推高当地农产品价格，从而驱动耕地扩张，而在其他途径上的土地利用或投入调整则很少。我们的估计表明，极端高温已导致大量森林损失，而到2100年的预计变暖可能使毁林面积额外增加2800万公顷。我们的发现挑战了这样一种观点，即资源再配置将减轻气候变化的环境后果；相反，我们的研究表明，当生产率下降时，农民会加倍努力并在本地扩大耕地。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Target What? The Foundations of Poverty Targeting
The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
With or Without U? Binning Bias and the Causal Effects of Temperature Extremes
abstract: Estimates of climate impacts show that extreme temperatures have large and wide-spread effects. To estimate these effects, a common approach counts days in different temperature ranges and considers how exposure to these distinct 'bins' affects outcomes. This often produces non-linear, U-shaped results, in which high and low temperatures have the largest effects. We show that non-linear approaches like these can generate spurious findings. Specifically, global warming induces trends in extreme temperature exposure that correlate mechanically with a location's baseline temperature. Substantial bias emerges if trends in the outcome variable also correlate with baseline temperature for any reason. We demonstrate this problem theoretically, in simulations, and with real outcomes. We then develop solutions. In applications using US data, some results in the literature are unaffected by these corrections, while other results change substantially. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 关于气候影响的估计表明，极端温度具有大范围且广泛传播的影响。为估计这些影响，一种常见做法是统计处于不同温度区间（“bins”）的天数，并考察暴露于这些不同区间如何影响结果。这通常会得到非线性的、呈U形的结果，即高温和低温的影响最大。我们证明，此类非线性方法可能产生虚假的发现。具体而言，全球变暖会引发极端温度暴露的趋势，而这些趋势与某地的基准温度机械地相关。若结果变量的趋势无论出于何种原因也与基准温度相关，就会产生显著偏误。我们从理论上、模拟中以及使用真实结果变量对这一问题进行了论证。随后，我们提出了解决方案。在使用美国数据的应用中，文献中的部分结果在这些修正之后仍然成立，而另一些结果则发生了实质性改变。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Financial Spillover Effects from Electronic Government Transfers: Evidence from an At-Scale Experiment in Indonesia
National Borders and the Conservation of Nature
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association (conditionally accepted)
abstract: We propose using finely-grained satellite data at national borders, where one political jurisdiction ends and another begins, to evaluate the net impact of national conservation policies. Using 30x30 meter satellite data along Brazil’s 12,800 km border in the Amazon, we find dramatic shifts in deforestation rates that align with changes in Brazilian policies. Between 2001 and 2005, at the tail end of a pro-exploitation period, annual deforestation in Brazil was more than three times the rate across the border. From 2006 to 2013, these differences disappeared as Brazil introduced policies to curb deforestation. However, they re-emerged in 2014 amid a period of dismantling environmental regulation. We show that both reversals were stronger in areas with weaker de jure protection and greater potential for exploitation. National borders provide a unique means to evaluate the effectiveness of national conservation policies, which are increasingly of international concern.
abstract_zh: 我们提出利用国界处的精细尺度卫星数据来评估国家保护政策的净影响，国界即一个政治辖区终止、另一个辖区开始的地方。利用巴西亚马逊地区长达12,800公里边界上30×30米的卫星数据，我们发现毁林率出现了与巴西政策变化相吻合的显著波动。2001至2005年间，正处于亲开发时期的末期，巴西的年度毁林率是边界另一侧的三倍以上。2006至2013年间，随着巴西推出遏制毁林的政策，这些差异消失了。然而，2014年，在环境监管被削弱的时期，差异又重新出现。我们表明，这两次逆转在法定保护较弱、开发潜力较大的地区更为明显。国界为评估国家保护政策的有效性提供了独特的手段，而这些政策日益受到国际社会的关注。

The Economics of Tropical Deforestation
abstract: Two factors have elevated recent academic and policy interest in tropical deforestation: first, the realization that it is a major contributor to climate change; and second, a revolution in satellitebased measurement that has revealed that it is proceeding at a rapid rate. We begin by reviewing the methodological advances that have enabled measurement of forest loss at a fine spatial resolution across the globe. We then develop a simple benchmark model of deforestation based on classic models of natural resource extraction. Extending this approach to incorporate features that characterize deforestation in developing countries---pressure for land use change, significant local and global externalities, weak property rights, and political economy constraints---provides us with a framework for reviewing the fast-growing empirical literature on the economics of deforestation in the tropics. This combination of theory and empirics provides insights not only into the economic drivers and impacts of tropical deforestation but also into policies that may affect its progression. We conclude by identifying areas where more work is needed in this important body of research.
abstract_zh: 近期学术界和政策界对热带毁林的兴趣有所提升，源于两个因素：其一，人们认识到毁林是气候变化的主要成因之一；其二，卫星测量技术的革命揭示出毁林正在以快速的速度推进。我们首先回顾了方法上的进展，这些进展使得在全球范围内以精细的空间分辨率测量森林损失成为可能。随后，我们以经典的自然资源开采模型为基础，构建了一个简单的毁林基准模型。将这一方法加以扩展，纳入发展中国家毁林所具有的特征——土地利用变化的压力、显著的地方和全球外部性、薄弱的产权以及政治经济约束——为我们回顾快速增长的热带毁林经济学实证文献提供了一个框架。这种理论与实证相结合的方式，不仅有助于深入理解热带毁林的经济驱动因素和影响，也为可能影响其发展进程的政策提供了洞见。最后，我们指出了这一重要研究领域中仍需开展工作的方向。

Cycles of Fire? Politics and Forest Burning in Indonesia
abstract: This paper examines the link between electoral incentives and environmental degradation by exploiting a satellite dataset on 107,000 forest fires and 879 asynchronous district elections in Indonesia. Fires represent a cheap but illegal means of converting forested land to other uses, but they risk burning out of control and creating substantial negative environmental externalities. We find a significant electoral cycle in forest fires. Ignitions and area burned decline during election years but steeply increase in the year after. The results suggest that politicians may suppress this activity at times when it might particularly dent their electoral chances.
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度尼西亚10.7万起森林火灾以及879次非同步进行的地区选举的卫星数据集，考察了选举激励与环境退化之间的联系。火烧是将林地转为其他用途的一种廉价但非法的手段，但火势有失控蔓延的风险，并会产生严重的负面环境外部性。我们发现森林火灾存在显著的选举周期。在选举年份，点火次数和过火面积有所下降，但在选举后一年则急剧上升。结果表明，政客可能会在这类活动可能特别损害其选举前景的时候对其加以抑制。

Citywide effects of high-occupancy vehicle restrictions: Evidence from "three-in-one" in Jakarta
abstract: Widespread use of single-occupancy cars often leads to traffic congestion. Using anonymized traffic speed data from Android phones collected through Google Maps, we investigated whether high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) policies can combat congestion. We studied Jakarta's "three-in-one" policy, which required all private cars on two major roads to carry at least three passengers during peak hours. After the policy was abruptly abandoned in April 2016, delays rose from 2.1 to 3.1 minutes per kilometer (min/km) in the morning peak and from 2.8 to 5.3 min/km in the evening peak. The lifting of the policy led to worse traffic throughout the city, even on roads that had never been restricted or at times when restrictions had never been in place. In short, we find that HOV policies can greatly improve traffic conditions.
abstract_zh: 单人单车的广泛使用往往导致交通拥堵。利用谷歌地图收集的安卓手机匿名交通速度数据，我们考察了高载客量车辆（HOV）政策能否缓解拥堵。我们研究了雅加达的“三合一”（three-in-one）政策，该政策要求高峰时段两条主干道上的所有私家车至少载有三名乘客。2016年4月该政策被突然取消后，早高峰的延误时间从每公里2.1分钟上升至3.1分钟（min/km），晚高峰则从每公里2.8分钟上升至5.3分钟。政策解除导致全市交通状况恶化，甚至包括从未受到限制的道路，以及从未实施限制的时段。简言之，我们发现高载客量车辆政策可以极大地改善交通状况。

Tax Farming Redux: Experimental Evidence on Performance Pay for Tax Collectors
abstract: Performance pay for tax collectors has the potential to raise revenues, but might come at a cost if taxpayers face undue pressure from collectors. We report the first large-scale field experiment on these issues, where we experimentally allocated 482 property tax units in Punjab, Pakistan into one of three performance-pay schemes or a control. After two years, incentivized units had 9.3 log points higher revenue than controls, which translates to a 46 percent higher growth rate. The scheme that rewarded purely on revenue did best, increasing revenue by 12.8 log points (62 percent higher growth rate), with little penalty for customer satisfaction and assessment accuracy compared to the two other schemes that explicitly also rewarded these dimensions. Further analysis reveals that these revenue gains accrue from a small number of properties becoming taxed at their true value, which is substantially more than they had been taxed at previously. The majority of properties in incentivized areas in fact pay no more taxes, but do report higher bribes. The results are consistent with a collusive setting in which performance pay increases collector's bargaining power over taxpayers, who either have to pay higher bribes to avoid being reassessed, or pay substantially higher taxes if collusion breaks down.
abstract_zh: 对税收征管人员实行绩效薪酬具有提高税收收入的潜力，但如果纳税人面临征管人员的过度施压，则可能付出代价。我们报告了首个大规模实地实验，专门检验这些问题：我们将巴基斯坦旁遮普省的482个财产税单位随机分配到三种绩效薪酬方案之一，或分配到对照组。两年后，受激励的单位其税收收入比对照组高出9.3个对数点，相当于增长率高出46%。纯粹以收入为奖励依据的方案效果最好，使收入增加了12.8个对数点（增长率高出62%），而与另外两种同时明确奖励客户满意度和评估准确性的方案相比，其在客户满意度和评估准确性方面的损失很小。进一步分析表明，这些收入增长来自少数财产被按其真实价值征税，而这一价值远高于此前的征税水平。受激励地区的大多数财产实际上并未多缴税，但报告的贿赂有所增加。这些结果与一种串谋情形相一致：绩效薪酬提高了征管人员相对于纳税人的议价能力，纳税人要么不得不支付更高的贿赂以避免被重新评估，要么在串谋破裂时被征收高得多的税款。

title: Promises and Perils of Pre-Analysis Plans

What Do We Learn from the Weather? The New Climate-Economy Literature
abstract: A rapidly growing body of research applies panel methods to examine how temperature, precipitation, and windstorms influence economic outcomes. These studies focus on changes in weather realizations over time within a given spatial area and demonstrate impacts on agricultural output, industrial output, labor productivity, energy demand, health, conflict, and economic growth among other outcomes. By harnessing exogenous variation over time within a given spatial unit, these studies help credibly identify (i) the breadth of channels linking weather and the economy, (ii) heterogeneous treatment effects across different types of locations, and (iii) non-linear effects of weather variables. This paper reviews the new literature with two purposes. First, we summarize recent work, providing a guide to its methodologies, data sets, and findings. Second, we consider applications of the new literature, including insights for the "damage function" within models that seek to assess the potential economic effects of future climate change.
abstract_zh: 一大批快速增长的研究运用面板方法考察温度、降水和风暴如何影响经济结果。这些研究关注给定空间区域内天气随时间的变化，并展示了其对农业产出、工业产出、劳动生产率、能源需求、健康、冲突以及经济增长等结果的影响。通过利用给定空间单位内随时间变化的外生变异，这些研究有助于可信地识别：(i) 天气与经济之间联系的广泛渠道，(ii) 不同类型地点之间的异质性处理效应，以及 (iii) 天气变量的非线性效应。本文回顾这一新文献，有两个目的。第一，我们总结近期的研究工作，为其方法、数据集和发现提供指引。第二，我们考察这一新文献的应用，包括对模型中“损害函数”（damage function）的启示，这些模型旨在评估未来气候变化的潜在经济效应。

Temperature Shocks and Economic Growth: Evidence from the Last Half Century
abstract: This paper uses historical fluctuations in temperature within countries to identify its effects on aggregate economic outcomes. We find three primary results. First, higher temperatures substantially reduce economic growth in poor countries. Second, higher temperatures may reduce growth rates, not just the level of output. Third, higher temperatures have wide-ranging effects, reducing agricultural output, industrial output, and political stability. These findings inform debates over climate's role in economic development and suggest the possibility of substantial negative impacts of higher temperatures on poor countries. (JEL E23, O13, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 本文利用各国境内历史上的温度波动，识别其对总体经济结果的影响。我们得出三项主要结论。第一，较高的温度显著降低了贫穷国家的经济增长。第二，较高的温度可能降低增长率，而不仅仅是产出水平。第三，较高的温度具有广泛的影响，会降低农业产出、工业产出以及政治稳定性。这些发现为关于气候在经济发展中所起作用的争论提供了依据，并表明较高温度可能对贫穷国家产生重大的负面影响。（JEL E23, O13, Q54, Q56）

title: The Political Economy of Deforestation in the Tropics
abstract: Tropical deforestation accounts for almost one-fifth of greenhouse gas emissions worldwide and threatens the world's most diverse ecosystems. The prevalence of illegal forest extraction in the tropics suggests that understanding the incentives of local bureaucrats and politicians who enforce forest policy may be critical to understanding tropical deforestation. We find support for this thesis using a novel satellite-based dataset that tracks annual changes in forest cover across eight years of institutional change in post-Soeharto Indonesia. Increases in the numbers of political jurisdictions are associated with increased deforestation and with lower prices in local wood markets, consistent with a model of Cournot competition between jurisdictions. Illegal logging increases dramatically in the years leading up to local elections, suggesting the presence of "political logging cycles".And, illegal logging and rents from unevenly distributed oil and gas revenues are short run substitutes, but this effect dissapears over time as political turnover occurs. The results illustrate how incentives faced by local government officials affect deforestation, and provide an example of how standard economic theories can explain illegal behavior.
abstract_zh: 热带毁林占全球温室气体排放的近五分之一，并威胁着世界上最具多样性的生态系统。热带地区非法的森林采伐十分普遍，这表明理解执行森林政策的地方官员和政治人物的激励机制，对于理解热带毁林可能至关重要。我们利用一个新颖的卫星数据集支持了这一论点，该数据集追踪了苏哈托下台后印度尼西亚八年制度变革期间森林覆盖的年度变化。政治辖区数量的增加与毁林增加以及当地木材市场价格下降相关，这与辖区之间古诺竞争的模型相一致。在地方选举前的数年，非法伐木显著增加，表明存在“政治伐木周期”。此外，非法伐木与分配不均的石油和天然气收入所产生的租金在短期内是替代品，但随着政治更替的发生，这一效应会逐渐消失。这些结果说明了地方政府官员面临的激励如何影响毁林，并提供了一个例子，表明标准经济理论可以解释非法行为。

title: Informal Taxation
Climate Shocks and Exports
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings 100(2): 454-459
abstract: This paper uses international trade data to examine the effects of climate shocks on economic activity. We examine panel models relating the annual growth rate of a country's exports in a particular product category to the country's weather in that year. We find that a poor country being 1 degree Celsius warmer in a given year reduces the growth rate of that country's exports by between 2.0 and 5.7 percentage points, with no detectable effects in rich countries. We find negative effects of temperature on exports of both agricultural products and light manufacturing products, with little apparent effects on heavy industry or raw materials. The results confirm large negative effects of temperature on poor countries' economies and suggest that temperature affects a much wider range of economic activity than conventionally thought.
abstract_zh: 本文利用国际贸易数据考察气候冲击对经济活动的影响。我们考察了面板模型，将一个国家某一特定产品类别出口的年增长率与该国当年的天气联系起来。我们发现，在某一年气温高出1摄氏度的贫穷国家，其该类出口的增长率会下降2.0至5.7个百分点，而在富裕国家则未检测到明显影响。我们发现温度对农产品和轻工业制成品的出口均有负面影响，而对重工业或原材料几乎没有明显影响。结果证实了温度对贫穷国家经济的巨大负面影响，并表明温度所影响的经济活动范围比通常认为的要广泛得多。

Temperature and Income: Reconciling New Cross Sectional and Panel Estimates
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings 99(2): 198-204
abstract: This paper presents novel evidence and analysis of the relationship between temperature and income. First, using sub-national data from 12 countries in the Americas, we provide new evidence that the negative cross-country relationship between temperature and income also exists within countries and even within states. Second, we provide a theoretical framework for reconciling the substantial, negative association between temperature and income in the cross-section with the even stronger short-run effects of temperature estimated by panel models. The theoretical framework suggests that half of the negative short-term effects of temperature may be offset in the long run through adaptation.
abstract_zh: 本文就温度与收入之间的关系提出了新的证据和分析。首先，利用美洲12个国家的次国家级数据，我们提供了新的证据，表明温度与收入之间在跨国层面存在的负相关关系，在一国之内乃至一州之内同样存在。其次，我们提供了一个理论框架，用以调和横截面数据中温度与收入之间显著的负相关关系，与面板模型所估计的更强的短期温度效应。该理论框架表明，温度的负面短期效应中有一半可能通过长期适应而被抵消。

abstract: Environmental externalities—uncompensated damages imposed on others—lie at the root of climate change, pollution, deforestation and biodiversity loss. Empirical evidence is limited, however, as to how externalities drive private decision making. We study one such behaviour, illegal tropical forest fires, using 15 years of daily satellite data covering over 107,000 fires across Indonesia. Weather-induced variation in fire spread risk and variation in who owns surrounding land allow us to identify how far externalities influence the decision to use fire. Relative to when all spread risks are internalized, we find that firms overuse fire when surrounded by unleased government lands where property rights are weak. In contrast, and consistent with the Coase Theorem, firms treat risks to nearby private concessions similarly to risks to their own land. Government sanctions, concentrated on fires spreading to populated areas, also deter fires, consistent with Pigouvian deterrence.
abstract_zh: 环境外部性——即强加于他人而未予补偿的损害——是气候变化、污染、毁林和生物多样性丧失的根源。然而，关于外部性如何驱动私人决策的实证证据是有限的。我们利用覆盖印度尼西亚超过10.7万起火灾的15年逐日卫星数据，研究了一种此类行为：非法的热带森林用火。火势蔓延风险的天气诱致变化，以及周边土地所有权归属的差异，使我们能够识别外部性在多大程度上影响用火决策。相对于所有蔓延风险均已内部化的情形，我们发现，当企业周边是产权薄弱的未出租政府土地时，它们会过度用火。相比之下，且与科斯定理一致，企业对附近私人特许经营地风险的处理方式，与对自有土地风险的处理方式相似。针对蔓延至人口聚居区的火灾实施的政府制裁也起到了威慑作用，这与庇古式威慑相一致。
